hook.excerpt: Southern Europe, an enclave in central Italy || rugged mountains || landlocked; an enclave of (completely surrounded by) Italy; smallest independent state in Europe after the Holy See and Monaco; dominated by the Apennine Mountains || Resources: building stone || Exports: washing and bottling machines, other foods, packaged medicine, woodworking machines, aircraft (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: rugged mountains || Southern Europe, an enclave in central Italy

climate.excerpt: Mediterranean; mild to cool winters; warm, sunny summers || occasional earthquakes

economy.excerpt: high-income, non-EU European economy; surrounded by Italy, which is the dominant importer and exporter; open border to EU and a euro user; strong financial sector; high foreign investments; low taxation; increasingly high and risky debt || Exports: washing and bottling machines, other foods, packaged medicine, woodworking machines, aircraft (2023) || Industries: tourism, banking, textiles, electronics, ceramics, cement, wine
